thread:
Elaine Park: Heads-up: PMs need a compact, unambiguous GA checklist that product, eng, SRE, legal, and finance can sign off on. Key lanes: public SLOs, Dedicated exceptions, support runbooks + training, monitoring/canaries + rollback, and billing/quotas visibility. Please confirm owners and any open risks. :clipboard:

Raj Patel: Ack. Engineering will lock the observable SLOs and provide canary pass criteria. Current canary snapshot: p95 ~ 112ms, p99 ~ 270ms on 512-token baseline. Draft SLO YAML attached for the public page.

Raj Patel: Draft public SLO (for copy into docs):
```
service: inference-api-hosted
slo:
  - latency_p50: "45ms"
  - latency_p95: "120ms"
  - latency_p99: "275ms"
  - availability_monthly: "99.9%"
  - error_rate_monthly: "<=0.5%"
```
Raj Patel: Engineering notes: p99 target assumes KV caching and default batching. For long-stream shapes (>3k tokens) we will document an alternate expected range and automatic fallback.

Tomas Vega: Monitoring + alerts: I'll build a short dashboard and two synthetics (short-probe: 10 tokens /30s; long-stream-probe: 3k tokens /5m). Proposed paging rules (draft):
- page if availability < 99% sustained over 5m
- page if p99 > 340ms for 10m
- page if error_rate > 0.75% for 10m
- ticket if synth loss rate > 5% over 20m
Tomas Vega: Also adding a rollback trigger: auto-rollback if canary error-rate > 1% for 10m, with an automated page to oncall.

Maria Lopez: Support/runbook status: runbook baseline written. Outstanding for GA: explicit on-call rotation matrix (nights/weekends), 6 anonymized sample transcripts for L1 training, and the billing dispute flow. I'll draft transcripts if finance provides the invoice snippet.

Sam O'Neill: Finance/FinOps asks: define exactly what counts as "burst" vs "reserved" so CS and customers understand invoice lines. Proposal: invoice will show two line types: "Reserved capacity (commit)" and "On-demand burst usage" with token rates. I'll publish an example snippet and a short reconciliation walkthrough. Also recommend we ensure internal retries do not consume customer free credits  bill only successful token responses.

Nina Chen: Legal take: keep credit language tight and non-prescriptive about operational mitigations. Suggested sentence for SLA page: "If the monthly availability SLO is not met, customers may be eligible for a pro-rated service credit per the SLA terms." Do not call fallbacks a separate guarantee; call them "automated fallback policies" and document limits.

Elaine Park: Docs ask: single landing page entitled "GA: What to expect" with sections: published SLOs, Dedicated contract note, support/runbook quick links, monitoring + canaries, pricing & invoice examples, and a customer checklist. Who volunteers to draft? Maria for runbook bits, Raj for SLO wording and fallback header, Sam for billing examples.

Raj Patel: Action items from eng: implement an x-model-fallback HTTP header when routing to quantized/compat variants; ensure KV cache warm path for pinned models; include request attribution header so billing maps to Hosted vs Dedicated accurately. I'll deliver header spec and SLO finalization by Monday.

Tomas Vega: I'll create dashboard and synth IDs and wire alerts to product pager by Thursday. I'll add rollback playbook step to the runbook and include the synth IDs in the doc.

Maria Lopez: I'll finish runbook snippets, escalation emails, and the 6 transcripts by Friday EOD if Sam posts the invoice example this week.

Sam O'Neill: I'll post an invoice mockup + burst/commit reconciliation example by Wednesday. Also drafting a short FAQ: "How burst billing shows up on your invoice" for the docs.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-04-05T14:22Z -> success. Canary traffic 5% for 90m. Observed metrics: p95=110ms, p99=268ms, errors=0.12%.

Nina Chen: I'll review the SLA sentence and the runbook escalation emails once SLO numbers are final. Also suggest we add an optional Customer Notification template for any multi-hour incidents that affect availability.

Elaine Park: Two governance decisions to call out for signoff: 1) We publish a single public SLO set for Hosted only; Dedicated/Private get contract-specific SLOs and won't be listed on the public page. 2) Burst billing will be line-itemed and visible in invoices; CS will get a reconciliation example for customer conversations. If folks agree, I'll consolidate this thread into the GA checklist artifact and route to Legal/Commercial.

Raj Patel: Recommend a small "latency expectation" table for the public page showing ranges by request shape (small, medium, streaming) to reduce support tickets. I'll provide numbers.

Maria Lopez: Confirmed I'll update the owner spreadsheet with the above dates and ping when transcripts/internals are uploaded.

Elaine Park: Thanks. If no further blockers, I'm treating this as the canonical negotiation thread for SLO publication vs billing transparency. Owners, please hit the dates and flag any escalations. :white_check_mark:
